paragraphs.text: Configurable static launch token for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin to configure a **persistent, static launch token** for the Web GUI,
preventing session expiration and authentication issues behind reverse proxies or across remote devi
enting session expiration and authentication issues behind reverse proxies or across remote devices.
By default, DSH generates an ephemeral, in-memory launch token every time the service starts. On hea
dless, reverse-proxied, or containerized deployments (such as Kubernetes with Traefik/Authentik), re
starting the process invalidates the current token. Accessing the dashboard from a secondary device
(e.g., a phone) requires retrieving a new token from the host logs.
`dsh-static-token` hooks into the `connection` service and overrides the generated launch token with
a fixed token defined via an environment variable or profile configuration.

- **Static Launch Token:** Keep the same token across service restarts and host reboots.
- **Environ
ment Variable Priority:** Reads `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` from the process environment first, with fallback to

profile plugin configuration.
- **Seamless Reverse Proxy Integration:** Simplifies setting up bookm

arks or forward-auth setups without constantly tracking server logs.
- **Zero Overhead:** Pure ESM,
no external runtime dependencies, minimal memory footprint.
You can supply your static token in one of two ways:
Export `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` in your environment or service definition:
Configure the token directly in your DSH profile configuration:
Once configured and restarted, authenticate any new device or browser by visiting:
DSH will set its standard 30-day signed session cookie and redirect to the clean URL.
